introH2: Staying Near Vejthani Hospital: What to Expect and How to Choose
introHtml: Vejthani Hospital sits at 1 Soi Lat Phrao 111, Bang Kapi, east Bangkok — a JCI-accredited private hospital well-known among international medical tourists for orthopaedic surgery, general surgery and specialist care. If you are travelling as a patient or accompanying a family member, finding the right accommodation close by makes a real difference over a multi-night stay. The hotels and serviced residences in this guide are all on or near Soi Lat Phrao 130 — the residential soi directly opposite Lat Phrao 111 — putting them roughly 1 km and a 4–5 minute drive from the hospital entrance. The neighbourhood is quiet, suburban and practical: local restaurants, convenience stores, a mall (The Mall Bang Kapi) nearby, and MRT Yellow Line stations within reach for days you want to head into central Bangkok. This article covers 6 hotels we have reviewed in depth, based on real guest review data. We cover honest pros, honest drawbacks, prices compared across 3 booking platforms, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Vejthani Hospital is at Soi Lat Phrao 111, Bang Kapi, east Bangkok. The hotels in this guide are mostly on Soi Lat Phrao 130, the soi directly opposite across Lat Phrao Road — approximately 1 km away by car (4–5 minutes). The MRT Yellow Line serves this area: Lat Phrao 101 Station (YL7) is roughly 380 m from 130 Hotel & Residence and about 1.15 km from Livotel; Bang Kapi Station (YL8) is about 1.5 km from Baron Zotel. The Yellow Line connects to the Blue Line MRT at Lat Phrao station, giving you access to the city centre without relying on a taxi for every trip. SC Park Hotel is the exception — located in Wang Thonglang, Soi Ramkhamhaeng 39, about 5.5 km from Vejthani (~12 min drive) — further but the only hotel in this group with a swimming pool.

entries.storyHtml: Among all the hotels near Vejthani, 130 Hotel & Residence Bangkok earns the top spot on pure merit — a Trip.com score of 8.9 from 1,019 reviews, the largest review sample in this entire guide. The 4-star, 168-room property on Soi Lat Phrao 130 sits just a 4-minute drive from Vejthani Hospital, with the MRT Yellow Line (Lat Phrao 101 Station) a comfortable 5-minute walk away. Genuine guest reviews consistently highlight rooms that feel larger and quieter than the price suggests, a varied breakfast buffet, and genuinely helpful staff. Honest caveats: no swimming pool, rooms facing the main Lat Phrao Road can catch traffic noise during rush hour, and Wi-Fi has been reported weak on certain floors.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request an interior-facing or higher-floor room if you are noise-sensitive. A 7-Eleven and Cafe Amazon are right next to the entrance — convenient for an early-morning coffee run before a hospital appointment.

entries.storyHtml: Baron Residence Bangkok is a 4-star, 125-room serviced residence on the same Soi Lat Phrao 130, also a 4-minute drive from Vejthani. What sets it apart from every other option in this guide is the one detail that matters most for multi-night medical stays: every single room comes with a private balcony — genuinely rare at this price in Bangkok. Guests accompanying patients for longer admissions consistently mention the free parking, the easy drive to the hospital, and staff who communicate well in English. Honest caveats: no swimming pool, you will need a car or Grab for most trips as the nearest MRT is a 12-minute walk, and some rooms show signs of ageing furniture.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: For stays of a week or more, contact the hotel directly to ask about long-stay rates — they often have deals not listed on the OTAs. The 31-sqm Family Room is the best value if you are travelling with a companion.

entries.storyHtml: SC Park Hotel Bangkok is the one full-service, full-amenity 4-star option in this guide — a 210-room property with an outdoor pool, kids' pool, gym, squash court, sauna, and three on-site restaurants. The trade-off is distance: at roughly 5.5 km from Vejthani, the drive takes about 12 minutes and you will need a car or Grab for all hospital trips. Genuine reviews praise the extensive breakfast buffet and clean pool. However, a number of reviews flag rooms with dirty air-conditioning units and weak Wi-Fi — book a free-cancellation rate and ask to change rooms immediately if you encounter either issue.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Book the free-cancellation rate. If you are assigned a room with a musty smell or AC issues, report it to the front desk right away — most guests who switched rooms were satisfied. Bring a backup mobile data plan for weak Wi-Fi.

entries.storyHtml: Livotel Hotel Lat Phrao Bangkok is a 4-star, 111-room hotel on Soi Lat Phrao 130 and the closest 4-star property to Vejthani Hospital in this guide at ~1.6 km. Its strengths are free parking, Wi-Fi rated at 8.6/10 by Booking.com guests, and staff praised in English-language reviews for attentive service. The honest caveat: the overall score is noticeably lower than the competition (Trip.com 8.1, Booking.com 6.8), reflecting inconsistent room quality in an ageing building — some rooms are well-kept, others noticeably tired. It works best for travellers who have their own vehicle.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a recently renovated room at check-in. The Saen Saep canal express boat pier (Wat Klang) is about 200 m away — a handy route into central Bangkok on days you do not need a taxi.

entries.storyHtml: Baron Zotel Bangkok is a SHA Plus certified 3-star boutique hotel with 58 industrial-loft style rooms on Soi Lat Phrao 117, just 1.2 km from Vejthani. Every room comes with a private balcony, there is free parking, and the hotel runs a complimentary 24-hour golf cart shuttle from the soi entrance to the main Lat Phrao Road. International guests rate the staff warmly for friendliness and English communication. One important update: the rooftop bar (Aladdin) is permanently closed, despite still being advertised on some platforms — verify before you book if that was part of the appeal. Some guests also report surprise credit card surcharges; confirm the payment policy at check-in.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Confirm directly with the hotel whether the rooftop bar and breakfast are still operating before booking. Ask about card payment fees upfront to avoid unexpected charges at checkout.

entries.storyHtml: Synsiri Ladprao 130 is a 3-star, 85-room hotel on Soi Lat Phrao 130 and the most affordable option in this guide — a Trip.com score of 8.3 from 320 reviews, which is better than you might expect at this price. It is about 1.5 km from Vejthani Hospital (~5-minute drive), comes with free parking, and every room has a private bathroom. Guests mention clean rooms and friendly staff. The honest trade-offs you need to know in advance: thin walls mean noise carries easily from neighbouring rooms and corridors, Wi-Fi can be unreliable for anything work-intensive, and there is no pool, no breakfast included, and no gym.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Bring a backup mobile data SIM if you need reliable internet. Request a higher-floor room away from the lift to reduce noise — the basic rooms are compact but functional.

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices shown are approximate starting rates for standard rooms and will vary by date and season — always check live rates on each platform before booking. Scores and insights in this guide come from reading verified guest reviews on booking platforms; we have not personally stayed at these properties. The majority of hotels in this guide are on Soi Lat Phrao 130, the residential soi directly opposite Vejthani Hospital's soi (Lat Phrao 111) — reaching the hospital means a short drive across Lat Phrao Road, roughly 1–1.6 km and 4–5 minutes by car or Grab. These are not walkable distances. Vejthani Hospital also operates its own "111 Residence" located immediately adjacent to the hospital — ideal for patients who need to be on-site. It is not listed on mainstream OTAs like Agoda, Booking.com or Trip.com; contact Vejthani Hospital directly to enquire. The MRT Yellow Line (Lat Phrao 101 and Bang Kapi stations) provides useful public transport links for days spent away from the hospital. Article by ThailandAddict.com.
faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Hotels Near Vejthani Hospital

faq.q: What is the best hotel near Vejthani Hospital Bangkok?
faq.a: It depends on what you need. For the highest guest score and an MRT within walking distance, 130 Hotel & Residence Bangkok (Trip.com 8.9, 1,019 reviews) is the top choice at ~฿800/night. For a long stay with private balconies, Baron Residence Bangkok (8.7) is the pick. For a swimming pool and full facilities, SC Park Hotel Bangkok (8.8) — though it is 12 minutes from Vejthani by car. For the tightest budget, Synsiri Ladprao 130 starts at ฿580.

faq.q: Is there accommodation right next to Vejthani Hospital?
faq.a: Yes — Vejthani Hospital runs its own 111 Residence, which is located directly next to the hospital. It is the best choice for patients who need to be on-site or immediately accessible. However, it is not listed on Agoda, Booking.com or Trip.com. You need to contact Vejthani Hospital directly to enquire about availability and rates. The 6 hotels in this guide are on nearby Soi Lat Phrao 130/117, roughly 1–1.6 km away by car.

faq.q: How much do hotels near Vejthani Hospital cost?
faq.a: Based on the hotels in this guide, expect to pay roughly ฿500–1,300 per night for a standard room. Baron Zotel starts at ฿500 · Synsiri at ฿580 · Livotel at ฿600 · 130 Hotel and Baron Residence at ฿800 · SC Park Hotel at ฿1,300. Prices rise during long weekends and peak periods. Always compare across Agoda, Booking.com and Trip.com — the cheapest platform varies.

faq.q: What is the easiest way to get from these hotels to Vejthani Hospital?
faq.a: The most convenient option is to drive yourself or book a Grab. From Soi Lat Phrao 130, crossing to Soi Lat Phrao 111 is roughly 1 km by road — about 4–5 minutes without traffic. The MRT Yellow Line has stations nearby (Lat Phrao 101 and Bang Kapi) but the hospital itself is not walkable from either station; you would still need a short taxi or Grab from the station. For Baron Zotel, use the free 24-hour golf cart shuttle to get to the main road, then take a Grab.

faq.q: Which hotel is best for a long stay during medical treatment?
faq.a: For extended stays, the best options combine private space, parking, and reasonable rates: Baron Residence Bangkok has private balconies in every room (including a 31-sqm Family Room) and is worth asking about weekly rates. 130 Hotel & Residence has suites for longer stays. SC Park Hotel Bangkok offers a Connecting Room configuration for families with a patient. Contact each hotel directly for long-stay pricing not shown on OTAs.

faq.q: Can I use the MRT to get around Bangkok while staying in this area?
faq.a: Yes. The MRT Yellow Line has two stations nearby: Lat Phrao 101 (YL7) — about 380 m from 130 Hotel and 1.15 km from Livotel — and Bang Kapi (YL8), about 1.5 km from Baron Zotel. From Lat Phrao 101 you can transfer to the Blue Line MRT at Lat Phrao station and reach Ratchada, Huai Khwang, Rama 9 and further destinations without a taxi. The Saen Saep canal boat pier (Wat Klang, 200 m from Livotel) is another route for reaching the eastern city quickly.
